name: tollbooth
description: Retype AI-proposed code changes before they land, so you actually read them.

commands.title: Tollbooth: Review AI Changes for Current File (from Clipboard)
Tollbooth: Generate AI Change and Review

tollbooth.contextLines.description: Number of unchanged context lines to show above/below each hunk.

tollbooth.maxChangedLinesRatio.description: If the diff touches more than this fraction of the file's lines, skip the typing flow and apply the change directly.

tollbooth.maxChangedLines.description: If the diff touches more than this many total lines, skip the typing flow and apply the change directly.

tollbooth.indentStyle.description: Indentation style to normalize AI-proposed content to before diffing and typing, regardless of what the source used.

tollbooth.aiProvider.description: Which AI provider to use for the 'generate AI rewrite' command.

tollbooth.model.description: Model name to request from the configured AI provider.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run typecheck
